name: Dynamic Home
description: Dynamic, permission-aware home recommendations for Jellyfin.
overview: Configurable and personalized sections for the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Removes Fast geschafft, Lange nicht weitergeschaut, Angefangen, aber vergessen? and Kurze Serien für zwischendurch, restores Hidden Gems in episode-heavy libraries, migrates old section preferences, and explains enabled sections with no matching content or a MediaBar-owned banner.

Ensures Continue Watching keeps the furthest season and episode per series even when an older episode was played more recently, restores native play actions by attaching completed rows atomically, and prevents Dynamic Home hero content from overlapping MediaBar banners.

Keeps every row scroll control reliable after Jellyfin upgrades or reattaches its legacy customized elements, synchronizes previous/next state after clicks, touch gestures and DOM parking, and preserves safe-area-aware row spacing.

Makes every row scroll control appear deterministically, keeps previous/next state synchronized after clicks, touch gestures and DOM parking, and preserves Jellyfin safe-area-aware left and right spacing.
Fixes Jellyfin 12.1's playback overlay TypeError by preserving the native pause/resume and scroller lifecycle when customized built-in home-row elements are not upgraded.
Restores the complete home DOM after late Jellyfin route commits while retaining the 1.0.1.30 bootstrap snapshot, idle image loading, row reconciliation and concurrent feed generation improvements.

Restores the complete home DOM in one operation, adds compact per-user SQLite bootstrap snapshots with silent background refresh and ETag support, loads artwork around the viewport in idle batches, retains unchanged rows and scroll positions, and generates up to four recommendation rows concurrently.

Restores resumable episodes that Jellyfin omits from the capped Resume response when LastPlayedDate is missing, places recovered progress at the front of Weiterschauen & Als Nächstes, and invalidates the prior instant snapshot so the corrected order appears immediately.

Keeps Jellyfin's native home rows hidden after late background refreshes, eliminating duplicate rows and extra layout work while retaining the 80 ms user-bound instant cache, background refreshes, native Jellyfin row structure, and touch-safe scrolling.

Eliminates the native-home flash and visible startup wait with a critical pre-paint bootstrap, a compact user-bound instant snapshot, background refreshes, and long-lived caching for the versioned browser client. Slow Jellyfin progress queries no longer block the visible home.

Matches Jellyfin's complete native home-row DOM and custom scroller, removes the plugin-wide box-model reset, and adds native card text spacing and hover controls so built-in and custom themes render Dynamic Home like original Jellyfin rows. Preserves complete row membership during rapid touch swipes.

Uses Jellyfin's native section, card, text, progress, indicator and navigation classes so Dynamic Home rows follow the active theme and Jellyfin's responsive card sizing. Preserves complete row membership during rapid mobile touch swipes.
Adds Jellyfin 12.1 compatibility with .NET 10 and the Jellyfin 12.1 plugin APIs. Installed through the normal Dev catalog and accepted at 320 px, 390 px and desktop with all 22 sections intact.

Stabilizes rapid mobile touch swipes with complete row membership before interaction, eager mobile artwork, and progress refreshes deferred until scrolling stops. Verified through normal Jellyfin Dev catalog installation at 390×844: all 22 sections, 64 favorites and 34 continue-watching cards remained intact after rapid alternating swipes.

Fixes mobile rows turning visually blank after scrolling. Adds previous/next arrows to every row header and hides horizontal scrollbars while retaining touch and keyboard scrolling. Verified through normal Jellyfin Dev installation and mobile acceptance at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 pixels.

Refreshes continue-watching after returning home, preserves resume and next-up entries without a second combined cutoff, and prefers the most recently resumed episode per series. Verified by normal Dev catalog installation, real stop/resume and next-episode playback tests, and mobile layout acceptance.
Responsive layout: consistent 16:9 library tiles and 2:3 posters, reliable card spacing and narrow-screen settings. Verified through normal Jellyfin Dev installation and desktop/mobile acceptance.

Shows dynamic recommendations as soon as their feed is ready while slow Jellyfin progress requests finish independently, preserving the mobile startup and incremental-rendering improvements from 1.0.1.18.
